The **Compound Bow** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

A sturdy compound bow with wooden limbs. Compared to the Bow, it has higher base damage with a slightly longer attack delay and longer time to fully draw. As all other bows, the Compound Bow is a silent weapon, meaning that it has a sneak attack functionality similar to that of a Suppressor. It cannot be equipped while wearing Power Armor.
